items.title: Unlocking Structured Pruning for Reasoning Language Models via Attention-Preserving MLP Trimming
items.title_zh: 通过保留注意力的 MLP 修剪解锁推理语言模型的结构化修剪
items.description: Structured pruning reduces LLM inference costs by removing model components to produce smaller dense models. However, existing methods can cause reasoning performance to collapse on long-form reasoning tasks such as AIME. We propose LayerTrim, a training-free structured pruning method that identifies redundant decoder layers and selectively trims their MLP features while preserving attention and decoder depth. LayerTrim is the first training-free structured pruning method designed to preserve long-form reasoning without gradients or recovery training. Across three reasoning language models and five benchmarks, LayerTrim outperforms existing structured pruning methods in most evaluated settings, improving average accuracy by up to 21.4 percentage points over RESP. On Qwen3-14B, LayerTrim achieves 1.24times faster prefill and 19.7\% lower peak GPU memory than the dense model, while better preserving reasoning ability. It also achieves the shortest average generation length among evaluated pruned models, while retaining the highest average accuracy. These results demonstrate that LayerTrim improves reasoning efficiency through both structural compression and reduced token generation.
items.description_zh: 结构化剪枝通过删除模型组件来生成更小的密集模型，从而降低 LLM 推理成本。然而，现有方法可能会导致 AIME 等长格式推理任务的推理性能崩溃。我们提出了 LayerTrim，一种免训练的结构化修剪方法，可识别冗余解码器层并选择性地修剪其 MLP 特征，同时保留注意力和解码器深度。 LayerTrim 是第一个免训练的结构化剪枝方法，旨在保留长形式推理，无需梯度或恢复训练。在三种推理语言模型和五个基准测试中，LayerTrim 在大多��评估设置中都优于现有的结构化修剪方法，与 RESP 相比，平均准确率提高了 21.4 个百分点。在 Qwen3-14B 上，LayerTrim 的预填充速度比密集模型快 1.24 倍，GPU 内存峰值比密集模型低 19.7%，同时更好地保留了推理能力。它还在评估的剪枝模型中实现了最短的平均生成长度，同时保持了最高的平均精度。这些结果表明，LayerTrim 通过结构压缩和减少令牌生成来提高推理效率。
items.authors: Woosang Lim, Haneul Yoo, Vincent-Daniel Yun, Sungjoo Yoo

items.title: Lluna: Collaborative Unimodal Models for Missing-Modality Inference
items.title_zh: Lluna：用于缺失模态推理的协作单模态模型
items.description: Pretrained unimodal models offer a flexible route to multimodal prediction through collaboration, but this collaboration can become less accurate than a surviving unimodal model when modalities are missing. We study this setting using fixed surviving-model anchors and find that collaborative gains can weaken or reverse as inputs disappear, even when the anchor's own input is unchanged. Our diagnostics further reveal reduced recovery of modality-specific information after aggregation and state-dependent collaborative representations. We propose Lluna, which combines a direct private prediction path from adapted unimodal features with a common graph-based collaboration branch that provides a residual correction. Progressive Collaboration Consistency organizes richer-to-poorer guidance along single-modality removals, aligning normalized common representations while task supervision adapts predictions to the available evidence. Across eight datasets spanning affective computing, scene understanding, and medical prediction, Lluna achieves the best evaluated average performance over non-full input states, improving Mean-Missing by 4.26\% on average relative to the strongest evaluated baseline. The fixed-anchor diagnostic also shows positive gains in mean collaboration under minimal inputs on all eight tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/AIFrontierLab/Lluna.
items.description_zh: 预训练的单模态模型通过协作提供了一种灵活的多模态预测途径，但当模态缺失时，这种协作可能会变得不如现有的单模态模型准确。我们使用固定的幸存模型锚点来研究这种设置，并发现随着输入的消失，即使锚点自己的输入不变，协作收益也会减弱或逆转。我们的诊断进一步揭示了聚合和状态相关的协作表示后模态特定信息的恢复减少。我们提出了 Lluna，它将来自适应单峰特征的直接私有预测路径与提供残差校正的基于公共图的协作分支结合起来。渐进式协作一致性沿着单一模态删除组织从丰富到贫穷的指导，调整标准化的共同表示，同时任务监督根据可用证据调整预测。在涵盖情感计算、场景理解和医学预测的八个数据集中，Lluna 在非完整输入状态下实现了最佳评估平均性能，相对于最强评估基线，平均缺失平均提高了 4.26%。固定锚点诊断还显示出在所有八项任务的最小输入下平均协作方面的积极收益。代码可在 https://github.com/AIFrontierLab/Lluna 获取。
items.authors: Haoyue Bai, Yinyi Luo, Heqing Huang, Xiaoyuan Yi, James Evans, Jindong Wang

items.title: Looking Complete Is Not Being Grounded: Evaluating LLM Sitreps Against Human-Authored Situation Reports
items.title_zh: 看起来完整并不意味着脚踏实地：根据人类撰写的情况报告评估LLMSitreps
items.description: Evaluation for automatic crisis reporting should measure what practitioners need, not what is convenient to compare. Through LLM-assisted, author-approved content analysis, we derive a 15-slot information schema from professional humanitarian situation reports using qualitative content analysis, then evaluate 121 human and 261 LLM-generated reports across five disasters and three hazard types. Under google/gemini-3.7-flash on Cyclone Idai, the best machine arm is nominally above the empirical human ceiling (0.827 vs. 0.821), but the difference is statistically indistinguishable from zero (95\% bootstrap CI [-.049,.059]; permutation p=.852), and the ordering does not replicate under openai/gpt-5.6-luna. On a blind 100-item Idai sample, the author agrees with the Gemini judge at 0.910 accuracy and unweighted Cohen's κ=.799. All four judges clear the plan's raw-agreement criterion of .7; only Gemini reaches .7 on chance-corrected κ. Across the three primary events, machine reports reproduce 5.4-11.0% of same-day official figures. Across those same events, raw exact-number matching links 14.3-19.6% of official figures and 85.4-90.1% of machine figures to the social stream; manual audit confirms 45/50 declared absences, 4/25 official matches, and 24/25 machine matches semantically. The issuing-provenance gap is positive in all 12 observed event-judge cells: report date, organisation, series, and authority were not supplied at professional-report coverage in any cell. On the three primary events, ROUGE-L is uninformative, BERTScore is negatively associated with completeness after multiplicity correction, and a generic LLM judge changes sign.
items.description_zh: 自动危机报告的评估应该衡量从业者需要什么，而不是方便比较什么。通过LLM协助、作者批准的内容分析，我们使用定性内容分析从专业人道主义局势报告中得出 15 个槽的信息模式，然后评估 121 份人工报告和 261 份LLM生成的关于五种灾难和三种危险类型的报告。在 Cyclone Idai 上的 google/gemini-3.7-flash 下，最佳机器臂名义上高于人类经验上限（0.827 与 0.821），但差异在统计上与零无法区分（95\% bootstrap CI [-.049,.059]；排列 p=.852），并且在 openai/gpt-5.6-luna 下排序不会复制。在 100 项 Idai 盲样本中，作者同意 Gemini 判断的准确度为 0.910，未加权的 Cohen κ=.799。所有四位评委均明确该计划的原始协议标准为 0.7；只有 Gemini 在机会校正 κ 上达到 0.7。在这三项主要活动中，机器报告再现了当天官方数据的 5.4-11.0%。在这些相同的事件中，原始精确数字匹配将 14.3-19.6% 的官方数字和 85.4-90.1% 的机器数字链接到社交流；人工审核确认 45/50 已声明缺席、4/25 正式比赛、24/25 机器语义匹配。在所有 12 个观察到的事件判断小组中，发布来源差距都是正数：任何小组的专业报告报道中均未提供报告日期、组织、系列和权威。在这三个主要事件中，ROUGE-L 没有提供任何信息，BERTScore 与多重性校正后的完整性负相关，并且通用 LLM 判断会改变符号。

items.title: When Left Is Right? Camera-Motion Understanding beyond Screen
items.title_zh: 什么时候左就是右？超越屏幕的相机运动理解
items.description: Can a vision-language model tell left from right? Modern VLMs solve visual puzzles and follow hour-long videos, yet when asked whether the camera moved left or right, most do no better than a coin flip. Adding camera-motion data or geometric representations has been tried, separately, and neither closes the gap. We argue that camera-motion understanding needs two conditions at once: the representation must couple off-screen camera motion with on-screen flow dynamics, and it must be interpreted by the language model rather than trained as a standalone pose or depth estimator. We propose CameraVLM, which pairs a motion-state representation with state-language alignment. Camera tokens capture how the camera moves off screen, flow tokens capture how the subject and background move on screen, and a two-stage training strategy keeps language in the loop so that both are learned together with camera-motion semantics. With only 9B parameters, CameraVLM outperforms all open-source and camera-motion-specific models by a wide margin across three benchmarks and more than 20 baselines, and matches or surpasses GPT-6 Astra as well as human viewers in a 48-participant study. Project page: https://3dagentworld.github.io/CameraVLM/
items.description_zh: 视觉语言模型能区分左右吗？现代 VLM 可以解决视觉难题并跟踪长达一小时的视频，但当被问及摄像机向左还是向右移动时，大多数的表现并不比抛硬币好多少。已经分别尝试添加相机运动数据或几何表示，但都无法缩小差距。我们认为相机运动理解同时需要两个条件：表示必须将屏幕外的相机运动与屏幕上的流体动力学结合起来，并且它必须由语言模型解释，而不是作为独立的姿势或深度估计器进行训练。我们提出了 CameraVLM，它将运动状态表示与状态语言对齐配对。相机标记捕获相机如何移出屏幕，流标记捕获主题和背景如何在屏幕上移动，两阶段训练策略使语言保持在循环中，以便两者与相机运动语义一起学习。仅使用 9B 参数，CameraVLM 在三个基准测试和 20 多个基线上大幅优于所有开源模型和相机运动特定模型，并且在一项 48 名参与者的研究中匹配或超过了 GPT-6 Astra 以及人类观众。项目页面：https://3dagentworld.github.io/CameraVLM/
items.authors: Chong Cheng, Ran Zhang, Xinyuan Li, Alan Zhao, Hao Wang, Xi Wang

items.title: PreciseCoder: Faithful and Generalizable Debugging Beyond Unit-Test Rewards
items.title_zh: PreciseCoder：超越单元测试奖励的忠实且可推广的调试
items.description: Reinforcement learning (RL) from unit tests is the common recipe for post-training code models, but a unit test only asks whether the final program passes. We analyze what this unit-test-only reward teaches a model during debugging and find that, while it raises pass rates, it also teaches the model to edit more and to hallucinate bugs in code that is already correct. We introduce PreciseCoder, a training algorithm that augments the unit-test reward with a signal for semantically verified, localized edits, which correlates with smaller edits and higher pass rates. On 4B, 9B, and 27B models, PreciseCoder reduces the average number of edit lines from 7-15to 3 at a pass rate on par with unit-test-only training. Trained only on single-line bugs, PreciseCoder can generalize to repository-level program repair, where it resolves more issues with smaller patches. Its precision also transfers from weaker to stronger models: given the reasoning trace of a 9B PreciseCoder model, frontier models such as GPT-5.6 Sol and Qwen3.8-Max gain 4.6-12.4 points in edit precision with no additional training. Linguistic analysis of the thinking traces shows that our reward encourages the model to reason about individual lines, name the buggy ones, and form consistent bug hypotheses.
items.description_zh: 来自单元测试的强化学习 (RL) 是训练后代码模型的常见方法，但单元测试仅询问最终程序是否通过。我们分析了这种仅进行单元测试的奖励在调试过程中向模型传授的内容，发现虽然它提高了通过率，但它也教会模型进行更多编辑并在已经正确的代码中产生错误。我们引入了 PreciseCoder，这是一种训练算法，可以通过语义验证的本地化编辑信号来增强单元测试奖励，这与较小的编辑和较高的通过率相关。在 4B、9B 和 27B 模型上，PreciseCoder 将平均编辑行数从 7-15 减少到 3，通过率与仅单元���试训练相当。 PreciseCoder 仅针对单行错误进行训练，可以推广到存储库级别的程序修复，用更小的补丁解决更多问题。其精度也从较弱的模型转移到较强的模型：考虑到 9B PreciseCoder 模型的推理轨迹，GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Qwen3.8-Max 等前沿模型在没有额外训练的情况下在编辑精度上获得了 4.6-12.4 点。对思维痕迹的语言分析表明，我们的奖励鼓励模型推理各个行，命名有错误的行，并形成一致的错误假设。
items.authors: Yunkai Zhan, Miaosen Chai, Shangshang Wang, Jike Zhong, Yuqing Yang, Deqing Fu, Serina Chang, Wang Bill Zhu

items.title: Drive3R: Block-wise Streaming Geometric Foundation Models for Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: Drive3R：自动驾驶的分块流式几何基础模型
items.description: High-fidelity closed-loop simulation for autonomous driving increasingly relies on dense multi-view 3D reconstruction. While recent feed-forward geometric foundation models have revolutionized per-scene optimization, applying them to continuous, long-horizon driving sequences is computationally intractable due to GPU memory limits and the quadratic complexity of global attention. Existing scaling strategies are fundamentally limited, as causal streaming suffers from compounding scale drift and trajectory deviation, while rigid "chunk-then-align" heuristics fragment global context and produce trajectory discontinuities. To address these limitations, we introduce Drive3R, a block-wise streaming geometric foundation model. Its block-wise causal attention resolves the scalability bottleneck of fully bidirectional attention while avoiding the loss of local future context in purely causal streaming. Its confidence-aware re-anchoring further mitigates long-range drift by detecting unreliable streaming states, re-initializing the KV cache, and stitching refreshed segments through SE(3) alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Drive3R establishes a new state-of-the-art on nuScenes, KITTI, and Waymo. Specifically, on nuScenes, it improves over the recent DVGT-2 baseline from 0.1806 to 0.1081 in AbsRel, from 0.6750 to 0.5344 in point-cloud Accuracy, and from 1.5812 to 0.9092 in ATE.
items.description_zh: 自动驾驶的高保真闭环仿真越来越依赖于密集的多视图 3D 重建。虽然最近的前馈几何基础模型已经彻底改变了每个场景的优化，但由于 GPU 内存限制和全局注意力的二次复杂性，将它们应用于连续的长视野驾驶序列在计算上很困难。现有的缩放策略从根本上是有限的，因为因果流遭受复合尺度漂移和轨迹偏差的困扰，而严格的“块然后对齐”启发式会破坏全局上下文并产生轨迹不连续性。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了 Drive3R，一种分块流式几何基础模型。其分块因果注意力解决了完全双向注意力的可扩展性瓶颈，同时避免了纯因果流中局部未来上下文的丢失。其置信感知重新锚定通过检测不可靠的流状态、重新初始化 KV 缓存以及通过 SE(3) 对齐缝合刷新的段，进一步减轻了长程漂移。大量实验表明，Drive3R 在 nuScenes、KITTI 和 Waymo 上建立了新的最先进技术。具体来说，在 nuScenes 上，它比最近的 DVGT-2 基线在 AbsRel 中从 0.1806 提高到 0.1081，在点���精度中从 0.6750 提高到 0.5344，在 ATE 中从 1.5812 提高到 0.9092。
items.authors: Tianyi Yang, Haojun Yang, Jipeng Xiao, Xuesong Chen, Shaoshuai Shi, Li Jiang, Zhipeng Zhang

items.title: Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation
items.title_zh: 下一代概念建模：快速、并行的粗到细文本生成
items.description: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallel sampling for faster generation than autoregressive models, an increasingly important advantage as inference becomes a dominant computational workload. However, DLMs degrade quickly with fewer sampling steps, process the full sequence at every step, and require many passes over the dataset to reach good quality. We introduce Next-Concept Modeling (NCM), a two-stage, coarse-to-fine framework: a multiscale residual VQ-VAE encodes text into a hierarchy of discrete codes, and a transformer generates one level at a time, predicting all codes within a level in parallel. At matched parameter scales, NCM achieves better generative perplexity than the strongest DLM baseline on LM1B while running 21times faster. On OpenWebText, NCM is competitive with the strongest DLM while running 10times faster; on XSum, it matches the strongest DLM's ROUGE-L while being 31times faster. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations.
items.description_zh: 扩散语言模型 (DLM) 提供并行采样，比自回归模型生成速度更快，随着推理成为主要的计算工作负载，这一优势变得越来越重要。然而，DLM 在采样步骤较少的情况下会快速退化，每一步都处理完整序列，并且需要多次遍历数据集才能达到良好的质量。我们引入了下一概念建模 (NCM)，这是一个两阶段、从粗到细的框架：多尺度残差 VQ-VAE 将文本编码为离散代码的层次结构，变压器一次生成一个级别，并行预测该级别内的所有代码。在匹配的参数尺度下，NCM 比 LM1B 上最强的 DLM 基线实现了更好的生成困惑，同时运行速度快了 21 倍。在OpenWebText上，NCM可以与最强的DLM竞争，同时运行速度快10倍；在 XSum 上，它可以与最强的 DLM 的 ROUGE-L 相媲美，同时速度快 31 倍。在数独推理任务中，NCM 在所有难度级别上都优于自回归和扩散基线，并且使用更少的函数评估。在数独推理任务中，NCM 在所有难度级别上都优于自回归和扩散基线，并且使用更少的函数评估。
items.authors: Hermann Kumbong, Ishan S. Khare, Iddah Mlauzi, Andrew Woen, Charles Ding, E. Kelly Buchanan, Simran Arora, Azalia Mirhoseini, Christopher Ré

items.title: Cortex: Measurement-Gated Evolution and Pruning of Coding-Agent Skills and Rules
items.title_zh: 皮质：编码代理技能和规则的测量门控进化和修剪
items.description:
Coding agents such as Claude Code also follow text files that developers write for them: a project file, skills the agent may choose to open, and rules that load automatically when the agent reads matching files. We call these files the agent's harness. Developers add to it whenever they correct the agent, but one success proves little: the same agent can pass a task once and fail it the next time.
  We present Cortex, a tool that tests changes to the harness instead of trusting them. It saves fixes from the developer's sessions as replayable tasks, finds the corrections that recur, writes one skill or rule at a time, and keeps it only if repeated runs with and without it show a net gain and no task made noticeably worse. Existing text is tested the same way before it is deleted, and Cortex neither adds nor deletes text the agent never used.
  We tested Cortex with Claude Haiku 4.5 on a repository built for the purpose, with conventions the model tends to break, one area with nothing to learn, and a script playing the developer. On held-out tasks, the harnesses it built made the agent follow the conventions far more often than no skills or rules did, left the comparison area unchanged, and added no text read on every turn. Rules, which load automatically, did most of the work; skills helped only when offered with the files a task touches, and those offered on every turn were rarely opened. Cortex kept none of the useless or harmful suggestions we planted, but the agent never opened the useless ones or the harmful skills, and it reached no verdict on the harmful rules, so the test shows that Cortex keeps no unused text, not that it detects damage. Under the stronger Claude Sonnet 5 a single run's harness added little, and on a real open-source project, where the agent was rarely corrected, Cortex found nothing to learn. We release the tool, the lab and its data.
items.description_zh:
Claude Code 等编码代理还遵循开发人员为其编写的文本文件：项目文件、代理可能选择打开的技能以及代理读取匹配文件时自动加载的规则。我们将这些文件称为代理的工具。开发人员在纠正代理时都会添加它，但一次成功证明是微乎其微的：同一个代理可以一次通过任务，但下一次失败。
  我们推出了 Cortex，这是一种测试线束更改而不是信任它们的工具。它将开发人员会话中的修复保存为可重玩的任务，查找重复出现的更正，一次编写一项技能或规则，并且仅在使用和不使用它的重复运行显示净增益并且没有任务明显变得更糟时才保留它。现有文本在删除之前会以相同的方式进行测试，并且 Cortex 既不会添加也不会删除代理从未使用过的文本。
  我们在为此目的构建的存储库上使用 Claude Haiku 4.5 测试了 Cortex，模型往往会打破惯例，一个无需学习的区域，以及一个扮演开发人员角色的脚本。在保留的任务中，它构建的工具使代理比没有技能或规则更频繁地遵循惯例，使比较区域保持不变，并且不添加每轮阅读的文本。自动加载的规则完成了大部分工作；技能只有在与任务涉及的文件一起提供时才有帮助，而每次提供的技能很少被打开。 Cortex 没有保留我们植入的无用或有害的建议，但智能体从未打开过无用或有害的技能，也没有对有害规则做出判决，因此测试表明 Cortex 没有保留未使用的文本，而不是它检测到损坏。在更强大的 Claude Sonnet 5 下，单次运行的工具几乎没有增加什么，而在一个真正的开源项目中，代理很少被纠正，Cortex 发���没有什么可学习的。我们发布了该工具、实验室及其数据。

items.title: History Replays Itself: Unleashing Long-Context Capability in Linear Attention
items.title_zh: 历史重演：释放线性注意力的长上下文能力
items.description: Linear attention promises the efficiency needed for long-context language modelling, yet its fixed-size recurrent state must simultaneously support ongoing computation and preserve information from an ever-growing history. This coupling has reinforced a prevailing view that the state's memory capacity defines the model's long-context capability. We challenge this presumed ceiling: recurrent computation need not bear the full burden of long-term storage. We introduce NoteBank, a sparse episodic memory that archives selected text before future queries are known, uses the backbone's native features for writing and addressing, and reads retrieved evidence through its native forward computation via replay. This training-free, plug-and-play interface requires no external embedding model, separately trained retriever, or separate neural reader. At one million tokens, it raises Gated DeltaNet's mean accuracy across six RULER retrieval tasks from 1.7% to 70.3%, with no observed significant retrieval degradation from 4K to 1M tokens. This recovery adds leqslant0.025% to analytical FLOPs, with persistent context storage approximately 1/2,600 that of a Transformer's full MHA KV cache at matched width, depth, and precision. Experiments extend from three 1.3B recurrent backbones to Mamba-2-8B and post-trained Qwen3.5-9B, demonstrating gains on LongBench v1/v2 and MemoryAgentBench. Together, these results show that sparse evidence storage and native replay can substantially expand the long-context capability of pretrained linear attention models while retaining the efficiency of recurrent computation.
items.description_zh: 线性注意力保证了长上下文语言建模所需的效率，但其固定大小的循环状态必须同时支持正在进行的计算并保留来自不断增长的历史的信息。这种耦合强化了一种普遍观点，即状态的记忆容量定义了模型的长上下文能力。我们挑战这个假定的上限：循环计算不需要承担长期存储的全部负担。我们引入了 NoteBank，这是一种稀疏情景存储器，可以在知道未来查询之前存档选定的文本，使用骨干网的本机功能进行写入和寻址，并通过重放的本机前向计算读取检索到的证据。这种免训练、即插即用的界面不需要外部嵌入模型、单独训练的检索器或单独的神经阅读器。对于 100 万个令牌，它将 Gated DeltaNet 在六个 RULER 检索任务中的平均准确度从 1.7% 提高到 70.3%，并且没有观察到从 4K 到 1M 令牌的检索显着下降。此恢复使分析 FLOP 增加了 leqslant0.025%，在匹配的宽度、深度和精度下，持久上下文存储约为 Transformer 的完整 MHA KV 缓存的 1/2,600。实验从三个 1.3B 循环骨干网扩展到 Mamba-2-8B 和训练后的 Qwen3.5-9B，展示了 LongBench v1/v2 和 MemoryAgentBench 的增益。总之，这些结果表明，稀疏证据存储和本机重放可以极大地扩展预训练线性注意力模型的长上下文能力，同时保留循环计算的效率。
items.authors: Li Nanbo, Firas Laakom, Yilan Zhang, Piotr Piękos, Yimeng Chen, Liangyu Wang, Yifan Xu, Mateusz Ostaszewski, Dandan Guo, Wenyi Wang, Yanning Dai, Yuhui Wang, Jürgen Schmidhuber

items.title: The Agent Knew: Internal States Forecast Unauthorized Actions and Stop Them, and the Lies That Follow
items.title_zh: 特工知道：内部国家预测未经授权的行动并阻止它们，以及随之而来的谎言
items.description: Language-model agents sometimes act beyond their authorization and then misreport what they did. On CAPE-Bench, matched agent tasks in which one fact decides whether an action is authorized, frontier open-weight agents do both, and one behavior marks the lie: retroactive permission laundering, acting and then asking permission as if the action were pending, precedes a false report in 70% of 1081 fresh informed violations, against 8% otherwise (preregistered odds ratio 7.0); frontier agents on tau^2-bench instead fabricate the authorization before violating. A linear readout of the agent's residual stream forecasts the violation before the action (AUROC 0.94) and the false report before the report, and beats chain-of-thought monitors when the agent is pressured to hide its reasoning. Gating every proposed action on this forecast cuts violations over whole episodes in four model families, and sending repeated flags to an approver keeps authorized work (Gemma-4: violations 0.70 -> 0.09, completion 1.00; a model approver that escalates unclear cases keeps this gain with a person seeing 25% of asks), at about 10-8 of the agent's compute and 109 times less than a chain-of-thought monitor. On AgentDojo, an external prompt-injection benchmark, the same readout calibrated on 29 tasks, with the steering unchanged, cuts attack success on unseen tasks in two families (Gemma-4 11.7% -> 5.7%, gpt-oss 28.5% -> 17.5%) while keeping benign utility (Gemma-4 0.637 vs 0.637; gpt-oss 0.667 vs 0.681). Preventing the violation is also the most reliable way to prevent the lie (misreported violations 0.10 -> 0.01 pooled over three families, preregistered), whereas lie-specific fixes after a violation are weak. All tests are preregistered and hash-locked; code, data and the full record, including tests that did not pass, are at https://github.com/AryaFayyazi/Honesty.
items.description_zh: 语言模型代理有时会超出他们的授权，然后误报他们所做的事情。在 CAPE-Bench 上，匹配的特工任务中，一个事实决定一项行动是否获得授权，前沿开放权重特工同时执行这两项任务，并且一种行为标志着谎言：追溯许可洗钱，采取行动，然后请求许可，就好像该行动待决一样，在 1081 起新的知情违规行为中，70% 的情况是在虚假报告之前，否则为 8%（预先登记的比值比 7.0）；相反，tau^2-bench 上的边境特工在违反之前伪造了授权。智能体剩余流的线性读出可预测行动前的违规行为（AUROC 0.94）和报告前的虚假报告，并在智能体被迫隐藏其推理时击败思维链监视器。对这个预测的每项提议行动进行门控，可以减少四个模型系列中整个事件的违规行为，并向审批者发送重复的标志可以保持授权工作（Gemma-4：违规 0.70 -> 0.09，完成度 1.00；升级不清楚案例的模型审批者可以在看到 25% 请求的人的情况下保持这一收益），大约是代理计算的 10-8 倍，比思想链监视器少 109 倍。在外部提示注入基准 AgentDojo 上，在 29 项任务上校准相同的读数，方向不变，降低了两个系列中未见过的任务的攻击成功率（Gemma-4 11.7% -> 5.7%，gpt-oss 28.5% -> 17.5%），同时保持良性效用（Gemma-4 0.637 vs 0.637；gpt-oss） 0.667 与 0.681）。防止违规行为也是防止谎言的最可靠方法（误报违规行为 0.10 -> 0.01 汇集在三个家庭中，预先注册），而违规后针对谎言的修复很弱。所有测试均已预先注册并哈希锁定；代码、数据和完整记录（包括未通过的测试）位于 https://github.com/AryaFayyazi/Honesty。
items.authors: Arya Fayyazi, Mehdi Kamal, Massoud Pedram

items.title: APEX-Harm: Evaluating Agent Safety in Shared Professional Workspaces
items.title_zh: APEX-Harm：评估共享专业工作空间中的人员安全
items.description: Professional agents increasingly work through command-line interfaces and multiple tools over shared workspaces containing files, messages, and business applications. These environments create safety risks that are difficult to capture with attacks placed at a single, known read location. We introduce APEX-Harm, a benchmark for evaluating prompt and script injection against long-horizon agents performing finance, consulting, and legal tasks in large workspaces. Each task contains 115 to 328 files, together with email, calendar, chat, document, spreadsheet, PDF, and code-execution tools exposed through MCP servers. The benchmark includes six attack categories covering static and dynamic injections, task-specific script replacement, and attacker-provided generic scripts, and evaluates attack success, exposure, and task performance. We evaluate 12 frontier models on 180 task instances per model. Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 have the lowest overall attack success rates (8% and 20%), while task-specific script replacement and attacker-provided generic script attacks remain substantially more effective, averaging 81-84% and 73% attack success, respectively. Gemini 3.8 Flash achieves the highest mean task score (0.877) while still exhibiting a 33% attack success rate. These results show that completing the requested task is not sufficient evidence of safe behavior: an agent can produce a correct deliverable while also performing an unauthorized action in the workspace.
items.description_zh: 专业代理越来越多地通过命令行界面和多个工具在包含文件、消息和业务应用程序的共享工作区上工作。这些环境会产生安全风险，而这些风险很难通过在单个已知读取位置进行的攻击来捕获。我们推出了 APEX-Harm，这是一个基准，用于评估在大型工作空间中执行财务、咨询和法律任务的长视野代理的提示和脚本注入。每个任务包含 115 到 328 个文件，以及通过 MCP 服务器公开的电子邮件、日历、聊天、文档、电子表格、PDF 和代码执行工具。该基准测试包括六种攻击类别，涵盖静态和动态注入、��定于任务的脚本替换和攻击者提供的通用脚本，并评估攻击成功、暴露和任务性能。我们在每个模型的 180 个任务实例上评估 12 个前沿模型。 Opus 5 和 Sonnet 5 的总体攻击成功率最低（8% 和 20%），而特定任务脚本替换和攻击者提供的通用脚本攻击仍然更加有效，平均攻击​​成功率分别为 81-84% 和 73%。 Gemini 3.8 Flash 获得了最高的平均任务得分 (0.877)，同时仍表现出 33% 的攻击成功率。这些结果表明，完成请求的任务并不足以证明安全行为：代理可以生成正确的可交付成果，同��还在工作区中执行未经授权的操作。
items.authors: Ziyi Yang, Adel Bibi, Guohao Li, Bernard Ghanem, Carlos Hinojosa

items.title: CLASHarness: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Conflict in Computer Use via a Controllable and Verifiable Generation Pipeline
items.title_zh: CLASHarness：通过可控且可验证的生成管道对计算机使用中的多代理冲突进行基准测试
items.description: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems to automate complex computer-use workflows, yet existing benchmarks mostly assume consistent, cooperative environments. In contrast, real-world collaboration rarely runs on consistent information: peer or sub-agents frequently report outdated states, issue contradictory instructions, or compete over shared permissions and files, forcing agents to check others' outputs and verify ground truth in the environment. Evaluating such conflict resolution remains challenging: manual authoring cannot scale across complex systems, while unconstrained LLM generation produces narrative drift, answer leakage, and unsatisfiable rubrics. We introduce CLASHarness (Conflict-Loaded Agent Scenario Harness), a controllable framework for generating verifiable multi-agent conflicts in computer use, with a benchmark of 600 multi-round tasks. By combining hierarchical scenario planning with an eight-step verified micro-pipeline, CLASHarness pre-commits decisive visual facts before rendering and compiles hybrid code and semantic graders directly from executed reference trajectories, guaranteeing every task is solvable by construction. Evaluating 15 frontier models on CLASHarness reveals three core bottlenecks. First, when sub-agent outputs conflict with the environment, weaker models blindly follow misleading information, whereas stronger models inspect visual evidence to verify ground truth. Second, resolving conflicts is much harder than finding them: while agents can spot inconsistencies, actively fixing system state drops task success significantly. Third, coordination protocols remain a universal bottleneck: even frontier models fail over 58% of closing actions, often forgetting to release shared locks or hand off tasks. CLASHarness provides a scalable, verifiable foundation for building reliable multi-agent systems.
items.description_zh: 视觉语言模型 (VLM) 越来越多地部署在多代理系统中，以自动化复杂的计算机使用工作流程，但现有基准大多假设一致的协作环境。相比之下，现实世界的协作很少在一致的信息上运行：对等代理或子代理经常报告过时的状态，发出矛盾的指令，或争夺共享权限和文件，迫使代理检查其他人的输出并验证环境中的基本事实。评估此类冲突解决方案仍然具有挑战性：手动创作无法跨复杂系统扩展，而不受约束的LLM生成会产生叙述漂移、答案泄漏和无法令人满意的标准。我们引入了 CLASHarness（冲突加载代理场景线束），这是一个用于在计算机使用中生成可验证的多代理冲突的可控框架，其基准为 600 个多轮任务。通过将分层场景规划与八步验证的微管道相结合，CLASHarness 在渲染之前预先提交决定性的视觉事实，并直接从执行的参考轨迹编译混合代码和语义分级器，确保每个任务都可以通过构造来解决。在 CLASHarness 上评估 15 个前沿模型揭示了三个核心瓶颈。首先，��子代理的输出与环境发生冲突时，较弱的模型会盲目遵循误导性信息，而较强的模型会检查视觉证据以验证地面事实。其次，解决冲突比发现冲突要困难得多：虽然代理可以发现不一致之处，但主动修复系统状态会显着降低任务成功率。第三，协调协议仍然是一个普遍的瓶颈：即使是前沿模型也会有超过 58% 的关闭操作失败，经常忘记释放共享锁或移交任务。 CLASharness 为构建可靠的多代理系统提供了可扩展、可验证的基础。
items.authors: Yuxiang Lai, Jike Zhong, Chengzhi Liu, Ming Li, Haonan Wang, Xiaofeng Yang, Liang Zhao, Youbao Tang, Ruixi Fan

items.title: Self-Conditioning Enables Deep Sequential Reasoning in Flow Matching
items.title_zh: 自调节可在流匹配中实现深度顺序推理
items.description: Recent work has explored visual reasoning through image generation, where models solve visual-reasoning problems by directly generating solution images. Intuitively, iterative samplers such as flow matching are well suited to this task, since each sampling step may resemble one reasoning step. However, in this work, from a circuit complexity perspective, we show that this intuition is misleading. We prove that as long as the model outputs satisfy certain mild regularity conditions, the trajectory of the vanilla flow-matching sampler can be simulated by a constant number of sequential rounds of parallel model evaluations. Consequently, additional sampling steps cannot increase the expressive power of a constant-depth backbone model under the standard complexity-theoretic model of transformers. We then reveal that self-conditioning, which conditions the model on the previous step's estimate of the final image, plays a previously unrecognized role in removing this bottleneck. Controlled experiments on diverse visual-reasoning tasks show that flow matching with self-conditioning achieves higher accuracy and greater reasoning depth than vanilla flow matching, and its performance improves with more sampling steps. Theoretically, we prove that with self-conditioning, a constant-depth backbone can achieve expressive power equivalent to that of space-bounded Turing machines. Our study suggests a design principle for future visual reasoning research: carry more information between sampling steps, so that additional steps translate into deeper reasoning.
items.description_zh: 最近的工作通过图像生成探索了视觉推理，其中模型通过直接生成解决方案图像来解决视觉推理问题。直观上，迭代采样器（例如流匹配）非常适合这项任务，因为每个采样步骤可能类似于一个推理步骤。然而，在这项工作中，从电路复杂性的角度来看，我们表明这种直觉是误导性的。我们证明，只要模型输出满足某些温和的规律性条件，普通流匹配采样器的轨迹就可以通过恒定数量的连续轮次并行模型评估来模拟。因此，在变压器的标准复杂性理论模型下，额外的采样步骤无法增加恒定深度骨干模型的表达能力。然后，我们揭示了自调节，即根据上一步对最终图像的估计来调节模型，在消除这一瓶颈方面发挥着以前未被认识到的作用。对各种视觉推理任务的对照实验表明，具有自调节功能的流匹配比普通流匹配具有更高的准确性和更大的推理深度，并且其性能随着更多采样步骤而提高。从理论上讲，我们证明，通过自我调节，恒定深��的骨干网可以实现与空间有限的图灵机相当的表达能力。我们的研究为未来视觉推理研究提出了一个设计原则：在采样步骤之间携带更多信息，以便额外的步骤转化为更深入的推理。
items.authors: Zeyang Zhang, Linxiang Gao, Meiqi Gu, Xingyan Chen, Minrui Luo, Kaifeng Lyu, Tianxing He

items.title: VLX-Go: Robust Embodied Tracking through Multi-Stage Learning and On-Policy Refinement
items.title_zh: VLX-Go：通过多阶段学习和策略细化实现稳健的体现跟踪
items.description: Embodied visual tracking requires a robot to identify a designated target from visual observations and control its own motion to follow that target through an environment. Following an isolated person is a comparatively simple demonstration of embodied visual tracking, but following the intended person among distractors remains challenging. Existing methods exhibit a substantial drop in success from single-target to distractor tracking, motivating a focus on the shared spaces that person-following robots must navigate. We present , a vision--language waypoint policy built around the hypothesis that visual and language representations should be aligned before tracking-specific motion is learned. The policy combines complementary frozen visual encoders, multiscale temporal context, a transformer backbone, and a lightweight head for robot-centric waypoint prediction. Its training progresses through vision--language alignment, multimodal reasoning mid-training, and tracking specialization on 19,532 oracle episodes. Compared with 41.54\% distractor-tracking success for our earlier OmTrackVLA model, the complete multi-stage recipe achieves 55.80\%. We then explore on-policy refinement using filtered oracle labels for states visited by the policy. This preliminary study adds 2.42 percentage points of distractor-tracking success, reaching 58.22\%, while reducing collision rate by 1.99 pts. The final policy records the highest distractor- and ambiguous-tracking success rates among the compared methods. These results support staged multimodal learning as a promising direction for tracking among distractors and motivate further study of on-policy refinement for person following in shared spaces.
items.description_zh: 具身视觉跟踪要求机器人从视觉观察中识别指定目标，并控制自己的运动以在环境中跟踪该目标。跟踪一个孤立的人是具体视觉跟踪的一个相对简单的演示，但在干扰物中跟踪目标人仍然具有挑战性。现有方法从单一目标到干扰物跟踪的成功率大幅下降，促使人们关注跟随机器人必须导航的共享空间。我们提出了一种视觉-语言路径点策略，其假设是在学习跟踪特定运动之前应该对齐视觉和语言表示。该策略结合了互补的冻结视觉编码器、多尺度时间上下文、变压器骨干和用于以机器人为中心的路点预测的轻量级头部。它的训练通过视觉-语言对齐、训练中的多模态推理以及对 19,532 个预言集的跟踪专业化来进行。与我们早期的 OmTrackVLA 模型的 41.54\% 干扰跟踪成功率相比，完整的多阶段配方达到了 55.80\%。然后，我们使用过滤后的预言机标签来探索策略访问的状态的策略细化。这项初步研究将干扰物跟踪成功率提高了 2.42 个百分点，达到 58.22%，同时将碰撞率降低了 1.99 个百分点。最终策略在比较方法中记录了最高的干扰跟踪和模糊跟踪成功率。这些结果支持分阶段多模态学习作为跟踪干扰因素的一个有前途的方向，并激励对共享空间中人员跟踪的在策略细化的进一步研究。
items.authors: Kyusong Lee, Heting Ying, Tiancheng Zhao

items.title: A Diagnostic Study of World-Space Human Recovery Under High Camera Dynamics
items.title_zh: 高相机动态下世界空间人体恢复的诊断研究
items.description: Monocular world-space human recovery methods excel on current benchmarks, but these rarely include fast camera motion. We introduce the K-Pop stress test, broadcast dance videos that combine fast, large camera motion with dense multi-person choreography. Leading methods produce plausible per-frame meshes on these videos, yet their world-space trajectories drift far from the performers' stage positions. Through a systematic diagnosis, we show that the camera and human estimates each remain self-consistent, and that the drift appears when they are combined at mismatched scales. Each is recovered at its own scale, so a mismatch between the two can turn camera motion into human drift that grows with camera displacement and becomes severe in broadcast dance videos. We derive a closed-form correction that estimates this mismatch and applies one scale to all performers, removing the drift while keeping their relative positions in one shared world frame. It requires no retraining and works with existing backends. Combined with physical constraints, the correction yields stable world-space reconstruction for choreography modeling, scene editing, data generation, and virtual reshooting.
items.description_zh: 单目世界空间人体恢复方法在当前基准测试中表现出色，但这些方法很少包括快速相机运动。我们介绍韩国流行音乐压力测试，播放将快速、大的摄像机运动与密集的多人编舞相结合的舞蹈视频。领先的方法在这些视频上产生合理的每帧网格，但它们的世界空间轨迹远离表演者的舞台位置。通过系统的诊断，我们表明相机和人类的估计各自保持一致，并且当它们以不匹配的尺度组合时就会出现漂移。每个���以自己的比例恢复，因此两者之间的不匹配可能会将摄像机运动变成人体漂移，这种漂移随着摄像机的位移而增长，并在广播舞蹈视频中变得严重。我们推导出一种封闭形式的校正来估计这种不匹配，并将一种尺度应用于所有表演者，消除漂移，同时将他们的相对位置保持在一个共享的世界框架中。它不需要重新培训，并且可以与现有后端配合使用。结合物理约束，校正可以为编舞建模、场景编辑、数据生成和虚拟重新拍摄提供稳定的世界空间重建。
items.authors: Hao-Jen Chien, Wei-Lun Chao, Yu-Lun Liu
